description: This source file defines the TopDownFormatter class responsible for rendering document elements from top to bottom within a PDF or document rendering context. It manages layout, page breaks, and element positioning, utilizing other rendering components and layout information.

classes.name: TopDownFormatter
classes.description: A class that formats and renders a series of document elements vertically, handling layout, page breaks, and element positioning within a rendering area.

methods.name: MarginMax
methods.description: Calculates the maximum of two margins, summing if either is negative.

methods.name: FormatOnAreas
methods.description: Main method to format document elements on provided rendering areas, managing layout flow, page breaks, and rendering order.

methods.name: FinishPage
methods.description: Finalizes rendering for a page, handling ending elements and preparing for the next page.

methods.name: IsForcedAreaBreak
methods.description: Determines if a page or area break is required before a specific element based on layout rules.

methods.name: PreviousRendererNeedsRemoveEnding
methods.description: Checks if the ending of a previous renderer should be removed to accommodate layout constraints.

methods.name: NextElementsDoNotFit
methods.description: Checks if subsequent elements can fit into the remaining area, considering layout constraints and maximum grouping.

methods.name: NeedsEndingOnNextArea
methods.description: Determines if the ending of an element needs to be deferred to the next area/page.
